business_problem: Audi needed a more flexible and scalable platform for SAP workloads and analytics so it could support rapid digitization, faster reporting and business-process modernization during a period of industry transformation.
solution_summary: Audi modernized core business processing on IBM Power Systems as part of a broader SAP transformation. The company moved important SAP workloads, including SAP HANA-backed analytics, onto IBM Power infrastructure supported by IBM PowerVM, IBM PowerHA, IBM AIX, IBM Db2 and IBM MQ. This stack gave Audi a resilient foundation for running high-value operational and analytical processes while reducing server sprawl. SAP Business Warehouse now runs on SAP HANA with large in-memory capacity on Power, allowing business users to analyze fresher data more quickly and improving decision-making. The surrounding IBM middleware and virtualization services help keep systems highly available and integrated as Audi harmonizes operations. Together, the platform delivers faster loading for analytics, smaller database footprints and enough flexibility to handle growing digital demands from connected vehicles, manufacturing and business operations.

solution_components.name: IBM Power Systems
solution_components.role: Hosts Audi’s modernized SAP and business-processing workloads with high performance and resiliency.

solution_components.name: IBM PowerVM
solution_components.role: Virtualizes the Power environment so SAP workloads can be managed flexibly and efficiently.

solution_components.name: IBM PowerHA
solution_components.role: Provides high-availability capabilities for Audi’s mission-critical business systems.

solution_components.name: IBM MQ
solution_components.role: Supports integration and reliable messaging between modernized business systems.

data_flow: Operational data from business systems is processed on IBM Power Systems, loaded into SAP HANA-backed analytics environments and then surfaced to users through faster warehouse and reporting workflows supported by IBM’s virtualization and integration layers.
business_outcome: Audi reduced infrastructure footprint, accelerated analytics and created a more agile platform for digital transformation and future business growth.
